entries.text: Let's go now to our science editor, eric parker, standing by in mount Avalon, Washington. Eric?
entries.speaker: News Anchor

entries.text: [ man ] I'm standing here... On an historic eve with a group of scientists who can barely contain their excitement... About this device, which looks like a large titanium bug. Its name is Firewalker, and next week will make its first descent into an active volcano. This amazing robot is the brainchild of volcanologist daniel Trepkos... Whose objective is to gather samples from the crater... Which may hold valuable scientific data about the earth's core.
entries.speaker: News Reporter

entries.text: "scientific data"? We're talking about revisiting the very origin of the earth, peering into the fire where it all began-- a human endeavor more important even than man's exploration of space.

entries.speaker: Dr. Adam Pierce

entries.text: I'd heard he was brilliant.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.speaker: Dr. Adam Pierce

entries.text: You think his luck ran out?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The team you just saw sent a distress signal yesterday... After failing to make a scheduled status report, and they haven't responded to any of our calls. By using remote telemetry we were able to activate Firewalker's camera. This is what we found. You're looking at the floor of the volcano. But this is the last thing we expected to discover. The dead man is phil Erikson, chief seismologist. Now, look at this.

entries.text: I wish I could explain. Daniel and I, uh-- [ scoffs ] I always played salieri to his mozart. I was never quite on his plane of intellect. But this time I found him slipping... Into madness. The way he began to control the others--

entries.text: You think he's responsible for what happened?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Whatever there is between me and Trepkos, I pray that he isn't. We've got 20 million tax dollars in this project. If word of it were to get out, it could destroy years of work. I'm afraid to go through proper channels.

entries.text: Yes, but silicon is the closest element to carbon. It reacts almost identically... With other elements the way it combines to form complex molecules. A silicon-based life-form has been one of the holy grails of modern science. Maybe Trepkos found it.

Our meddling intellect misshapes the beauteous forms of things. We murder to dissect. My mind is a tangled knot I can no longer untie.

entries.text: A guide?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Yeah, a guide. Look, I've been up here for almost a year. I spent months in those caves, charting every fissure, every crevice, so Firewalker wouldn't trip. If Trepkos is there, I can find him.
entries.speaker: Jason Ludwig

entries.text: Why are you so eager to help me find him?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Oh, I-I-I'm not eager. I just don't feel like waiting for Trepkos to do to me what he did to Pierce and Erikson. Plus, you've got the gun. You're the only one who can get us out of this place.
entries.speaker: Jason Ludwig

entries.text: Whatever I'm smelling-- is it toxic?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Between the heat and the sulphur it can get pretty nasty in here, but it won't hurt you. You'll get used to it.
entries.speaker: Jason Ludwig

entries.text: How far does the cave extend?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: About three-quarters of a mile to the crater rim. Let's head in. It twists around quite a bit till you get there. Lots of dead ends... And blind drops, and unless you know where you're going... You're like a rat in a maze.
entries.speaker: Jason Ludwig

entries.text: [ screams ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ footsteps approach ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Your gun. Back. Get back.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: Why you doin' this, Trepkos? He's already dead. How many times do you have to kill him?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It's not him I'm tryin' to kill.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: I have attempted to culture the spore using temperatures... Ranging from human basal to those approximating the volcanic interior. I have used nutritive mediums containing... Human tissue, blood and saliva, even sulphur, however, none of the seven trials have successfully grown... The fungus that killed Tanaka. Based on this preliminary data, I've come to the following hypothesis: unless these spores are ingested or inhaled... By the host organism immediately upon their release, they become harmless-- effectively dead. Jesse?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What is it?
entries.speaker: Jesse O'Neil

entries.text: I thought you might like to know chances are good that none of us were infected.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ coughing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: We were at a safe distance from Tanaka when the spores scattered, and as soon as Mulder and Ludwig come back, we can leave. I-I just need to run a few more tests, but I think we're gonna be okay.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ gasping, whimpering ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Okay, Jesse? Jesse?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What went wrong, Trepkos? Firewalker carried something back to the surface.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Firewalker brought up an elephant. The truth... Is an elephant... Described by three blind men. First man touches the tail and says it's a rope. The second man feels the rough leg, says it's a tree. The third man feels the trunk, says it's a snake.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: What about you? What do you say it is?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I say the earth holds some truths best left buried.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: Like the spore?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Who are you?
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: I'm special agent Mulder. I'm with the FBI
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You don't look like a policeman.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: I came down here to investigate Erikson's death.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's not why you're here. You still believe you can petition heaven to get some penetrating answer. If you found that answer, what would you do with it?
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: I just want to know what happened after the first descent. What did you find?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It was porous-- obsidian. Erikson thought it was some sort of rock, so I told him to pulverize it for analysis.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: Erikson released the spore?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He discovered a new life-form. In a single moment, everything that science held sacred suddenly turned on its head.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: What about Erikson? If-- if he was infected--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I was too immersed in the work to notice. I'd been alone in the lab for three days... When I heard their screams. They were all gathered around him. By the time I realized what was happening, they were already changing. The spore grew in each of them until it became--
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It's a parasite. It lives to find a host.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: But you weren't infected.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: You destroyed your work, transmitting equipment. You killed Pierce so no one could leave.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No one can leave.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: What about O'Neil?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Jesse?
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: Was she exposed to the spore?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: They were all exposed. All of them.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: I have a colleague-- a friend-- who's with O'Neil right now. Let me go to her.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: She may already be infected. I can't let you leave.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: Then you're gonna have to shoot me, because I'm walking out of here.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Jesse?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ gasps ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: God, you scared me!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ wheezing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Jesse, are you okay?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ gagging ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Jesse, what's wrong? Jesse? Jesse, what are you doing?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ wheezing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ grunting ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ gagging ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ gasping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ moans, sighs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ door opens ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Scully! Scully!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'm okay. I'm okay.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ sighs ] you all right?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'm okay. Yeah. Look at her-- she was infected. I don't know how.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Erikson was the original host. When the fungus shed its spores, everyone was at ground zero, except for Trepkos.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ door opens ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Did you find him?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I told her... It would change her life.
entries.speaker: Daniel Trepkos

entries.text: Search and rescue, this is agent Mulder. Do you copy?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: This is army biohazard. How many are in your party?
entries.speaker: Radio

entries.text: We have two survivors-- agent Scully and myself.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Copy that. Our e.t.a. Is seven minutes.
entries.speaker: Radio

entries.text: Mulder, what are you doing? They're gonna want to question him.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It's all over, Scully. He won't talk. Scully and I are in the third day of a month-long quarantine, undergoing level four decon procedures. We are, so far, without symptoms of fungal contamination. All our specimens and field notes were confiscated... By the military biohazard corps prior to our evacuation. Their presence has delayed for an indefinite period... The arrival of the USGS Data retrieval team. I suspect, though, that there will be little left for them to retrieve. There are no plans at present to explore further any of the hundreds... Of volcanically active mountains in the Cascade range, including mount Avalon. All access points to that volcano have been sealed off by army engineers. Of the members of the Firewalker descent team, only Trepkos and O'Neil remain unaccounted for. They are presumed dead, and the search for them has been abandoned. Firewalker, however, was recovered, though its sensory and locomotive systems were found to be irreparably damaged. The data it collected from the earth's interior will never be known, and of the events that occurred at mount Avalon between the 11th and 13th of november, 1994, mine stands as the only record.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
